checks.name: quorum-intersection
checks.detail: All 16 pairs of majorities for three fixed acceptors.

checks.name: paxos-message-interleavings
checks.detail: 8953 reachable states and 29878 transitions; two ballots/three acceptors/fixed membership, crash-stop or durable restart. Not an unbounded proof.

checks.name: chosen-is-not-learned
checks.detail: Acceptance quorum can exist before a later proposer/learner acts; no client ACK is needed for chosen.

checks.name: value-inheritance-mutant-killed
checks.detail: A,B chose X at5. A proposer using B,C at8 must retain X; choosing wanted Y would create a second chosen value.

checks.name: forget-promise-mutant-killed
checks.detail: A durable promise20 rejects ACCEPT10. Resetting it to0 admits the delayed message and violates the persistence invariant; this alone is not claimed to be a full conflicting-decision execution.

checks.name: old-term-trace-election3
checks.detail: S5 has term1 prefix, wins term3 from S3,S4,S5, appends Y locally.

checks.name: old-term-trace-election4
checks.detail: S1 with X term2 wins term4 from S1,S2,S3.

checks.name: old-term-majority-is-insufficient
checks.detail: Even with X on three nodes, S5 with last term3 can win term5 and replace X. Mutant majority-only commit guard is rejected.

checks.name: current-term-prefix-protected
checks.detail: Committing a term4 no-op on S1,S2,S3 protects prefix X; S3 will reject candidate last term3.

checks.name: append-conflict-and-idempotence
checks.detail: Conflict replaces suffix; a duplicated shorter matching request does not truncate a later matching entry.

checks.name: heartbeat-bounds-commit
checks.detail: Last matched index5, not arbitrary local end9; mutant local-end guard would apply an unmatched suffix.

checks.name: stale-term-rejected
checks.detail: Old leader AppendEntries rejected even with a matching prev entry.

checks.name: deterministic-replay
checks.detail: Independent replay of authored command sequence; corrects source Figure23.10 z label, no native service execution.

checks.name: backup-input-order
checks.detail: Replicating a set of messages without its agreed order does not replicate state.

checks.name: two-level-commit
checks.detail: Coordinator consensus cannot replace a missing durable YES from a data participant. Two participant groups differ from replicas within each group.

scope: Finite educational state models, one fixed Paxos instance with two ballots and three acceptors; selected Raft rules and a five-node trace. No network, ZooKeeper, Spanner or native consensus cluster executed. Liveness and arbitrary histories are explained by arguments, not established by these finite tests.
